repo.description:
### Impact
An incorrect sanitizer in Jellyfin has been discovered that potentially allows a malicious user to create SyncPlay groups with names of unlimited size. Coupled with an arbitrary changing Group ID, this can lock out the endpoint and cause a DoS to other clients attempting to join this or other SyncPlay groups, as well as significantly increase the memory usage of the Jellyfin process possibly leading to an OOM crash.

### Patches
This issue has been fixed in 10.11.7 (and backported to master) via improved sanitization of the affected API endpoint, limiting the maximum size of a name.

### Workarounds
N/A

### References
For accurate details, please refer to: [report.md](https://gist.github.com/0xcyborg/8cc77adb674dfc0c42f2c6061778d8de)
repo.summary: Potential Application DoS from excessively large SyncPlay group names
